quote: we present MSˆ2, a multi-document summarization dataset in the biomedical domain. Our contributions in this paper are as follows: • We introduce MSˆ2, a dataset of 20K reviews and 470k studies summarized by these reviews. • We define a texts-to-text MDS task based on MSˆ2, by identifying target summaries in each review and using study abstracts as input documents. We develop a BART-based model for this task
